correctness.rationale: Every idempotent is the predecessor projection of its fixed set containing 1. In a gap between common fixed points (also the terminal gap), suppose a fixed point of the second map alone follows one of the first map alone. At that later point the first projection lands on a first-only point; applying the second projection then strictly decreases it. The composites differ. If at most one exclusive color occurs, the two composites both return the preceding common point. Hence commuting pairs and triples have intersection product. Scanning the three pair conditions together yields the stated 13 reachable states and the letter weights for all four ranks. Independently formed every allowed transition, verified the row totals for all four orbits and assigned weight u to the one all-ones transition to state zero per row. The resulting formal resolvent simplifies to the displayed bivariate fraction. At u=1 its reduced denominator has degree four, and expanding it gives the initial values and recurrence. Removing the all-ones reset letter splits each word of product rank k into k unconstrained gap words in the rank-one gap language, with n-k total gap letters, giving the claimed coefficient and G. Independent replay /workspace/replay/01.py enumerated monotone regressive maps by their values, tested idempotence and commutation by actual composition, and compared every joint profile and total through n=7. The finite comparison supports, but does not substitute for, the all-length transfer argument. Frozen checker inspected but not executed.

evidence: On the path, the 0-Hecke pair flags are 0 (no end component), 3 (both support bits still allowed), 1, or 2. For every possible next letter, flags 0 and 3 have the identical effect; merge them and interchange the singleton flag labels by complementation. This yields the Catalan pair scan. The three simultaneous flags give the same reachable 13-state weighted scan from the empty path.

The prior transfer already distinguishes each letter b: replace its unit weight by x^(1-b1)y^(1-b2)z^(1-b3)u^[b=000]. The 000 letter resets all pairs, and its count is product rank minus one. Thus the joint transfer is direct monomial weighting and the product-rank refinement is a separator decomposition. No new admissibility or rank statistic beyond the complemented support colors has to be computed.

evidence: The assigned Resultary hit 494cdd8f9928 is just the same record. Distinct 9c539e50bc8b, Proof §§1–2, characterizes commuting 0-Hecke parabolic supports J,K by every connected component of J union K lying wholly in one support.

For each Catalan fixed set S containing 1 take J=[n] minus S on the path with vertices 2,...,n. Union-components are exactly the gaps between common fixed points after omitting point 1; a component lies in one support iff it does not contain both exclusive fixed-point colors. This condition is pairwise, hence the same labeled three-color words (including repetitions) are counted on both sides, with path length n-1.

originality.rationale: A distinct same-date Resultary result on 0-Hecke idempotents covers more than a matching sequence. Its type-A path instance is bijective at the level of allowed ordered triples of membership words and directly gives the quartic counts. The refinements are mechanically recovered from the same published transfer: use complement bits as rank increments and mark the all-absent support color as a separator. Even the 13-state scan is the path transfer after collapsing the two indistinguishable neutral pair flags. The reports are dated the same day; this is exact and mechanically implied coverage, not a claim about publication order.

value.rationale: Simultaneous rank profiles in a natural commutation monoid would be a worthwhile exact invariant if they required a new enumeration. Here the path criterion and transfer already enumerate the same colored words. The four ranks are immediate complement-letter weights, and the shorter flags merge identical future behavior. Renaming the objects and making those reweightings does not give a distinct valuable residual to repair.
